_comment: Field-specific hints for LLM metadata annotation. Each key must match a field name in DocumentMetadata. 'hints' is free-text guidance; 'examples' are short indicator→value pairs drawn from real documents.

petitioner_occupation.hints: Occupations are often stated directly after the petitioner's name, or in phrases like 'in zijn hoedanigheid als ...' or 'van beroep ...'.

construction_works.hints: True when the document requests reimbursement, subsidy, or permission for any building, repair, or infrastructure work. Look for words like gevelbekleding, herstellingswerken, bouwwerken, façade.

is_job_application.hints: True only when the petitioner explicitly requests a named position, office, or appointment — not a general financial request.

examples.indicator: verzoekt aangesteld te worden als notaris
solliciteert naar de betrekking van schoolmeester

military_service_argument.hints: True when past military service — of the petitioner or a direct family member — is cited as a reason supporting the request.

examples.indicator: gezien zijn dienst bij het leger van Napoleon
als veteraan van de campagne van 1815
wiens vader gesneuveld is in dienst van het vaderland

petition_type.hints: Choose the single best-fitting type. 'Job application' overlaps with is_job_application=true. 'Request for financial aid' covers pensions, subsidies, reimbursements.

examples.indicator: verzoekt een attest van goed gedrag

petitioner_gender.hints: Infer from title or marital-status words only. 'weduwe' → Female, 'de heer' / 'den ondergeteekenden' → Male. Do not guess from a first name alone.
